title: [nightly/cleanup] Review bots' poster: one anchoring rule, a summary in parts, a shorter main
summary: The script that turns the review bots' output into PR reviews gets one documented anchoring rule (inline, range, suggestion) instead of four overlapping branches, a summary built from parts, and a 110-line main split into named steps. 32 new tests and a 105,000-case differential check show identical output.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/cleanup.
Two bugs found and pinned, not fixed: a backwards range makes GitHub reject the whole review, and a deleted file's +++ /dev/null counts as an added line.
reviewFirst: _anchor against the old block in collect_findings.
The fix-PR and suggested counts in the summary and the printed line.
next: Fix backwards ranges so a bot review isn't rejected.
Treat +++ /dev/null as a header in added_source.
